title: INSID3: Fast In-Context Segmentation with DINOv3
summary: INSID3 is a training-free framework for high-performance object segmentation that utilizes the emergent properties of Meta's DINOv3 vision foundation model. It identifies object regions through agglomerative clustering of dense features and removes positional biases via a simple orthogonal projection.
research_notes: Demonstrates 3.4x faster inference speed than multi-stage pipelines while outperforming state-of-the-art methods by +7.5% mIoU.

evolution.summary: Following its research debut, INSID3 was selected for an Oral presentation at CVPR 2026 and officially released with full code and interactive demos. It has since established itself as a benchmark for training-free, single-backbone segmentation frameworks.
